James is a big supporter of environmentally sustainable wineries that cultivate their vineyards biodynamically. Without using any synthetic chemicals, biodynamic is an almost religious dedication to organic methods in the vineyard, and it is canonized by the late scientist and philosopher Rudolf Steiner. The bottom line is that the vineyards are not manipulated in any way. The winemakers look at the vineyard as a complete ecosystem, treating the environment with a deep respect. The wines below are 10 of James’ favorite. Enjoy the exceptional quality and the unique energy of these bottles.
As always, we work with Asia Tatler to inform wine consumers, collectors and trade on what James is tasting, as well as our definitive selections each year. This August, Asia Tatler published James’ list of favorite organic wines from around the world. Read the full Tatler article in PDF to learn more about these organic delights!
